title: Molar dissolution heat
hints: Convert kJ per sample to kJ per mole.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: The salt dissolution absorbs $+2.50$ kJ, so $\Delta H_\mathrm{diss}=+2.50/0.125=+20.0$ kJ/mol.
statement:
Dissolving 0.125 mol of a salt in an insulated coffee cup removes 2.50 kJ from the solution and cup. What is the molar enthalpy of dissolution?

[_]{a}

explanations: The process gains the heat lost by its surroundings.
Multiplying by moles gives the wrong units.
The value must be divided by the amount.
